subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Following up on my earlier email about activation-quality acquisition for {Brand}. Since US Mobile teed up its sub-$50 multi-carrier bundle with Starlink, the switch decision is more layered and harder to win on price alone. With telecom customer acquisition cost averaging around $350 and North America app installs running $2.50 to $5.00, the gap between an install and a paid, network-activated line is where budget leaks. We hold out a control group so the paid activations read as incremental to your organic switchers. Worth comparing against your current source mix?
angle: fresh angle: timely US Mobile + Starlink multi-carrier bundle (sourced) + telecom CAC and NA CPI bands
